name: read-only-git-over-a-keel-path-stays-allowed
description: `status`, `diff`, `log`, `show`, `ls-files`, `grep` and `stash list` are none of the four restore-semantics subcommands, so this rule never asks them anything about .keel/ - they still face rule 2's own plan gate exactly as before (fixtures 56/78), which the fresh plan on file here satisfies.

files.text:
# Plan

- [ ] T1: the thing | AC: it works

tool_input.command: git status -- .keel/audit/keel-audit.jsonl && git diff -- .keel/queue/keel-observations.jsonl && git log -- .keel/plans/keel-plan-$SESS8.md && git show HEAD:.keel/audit/keel-audit.jsonl && git ls-files .keel/ && git grep -n tier -- .keel/keel-policy.md && git stash list
